'''Shooter''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]] [[Red Group (Galactic Republic)|Red Group]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He died sacrificing himself destroying the new CIS ship by crashing into the core.<ref name="Hotshot (comic)" />
